subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add portable multi-select to `MessagePresentation`, and which channels and fallback guarantees must the first supported contract include?
rationale: Source inspection establishes the missing capability, but code alone cannot choose the permanent public SDK semantics, Telegram strategy, or minimum cross-channel support bar.

options.title: Add a portable presentation block
options.body: Define an additive typed multi-select contract with structured array results, ship Discord and Slack native implementations first, and require deterministic text fallback elsewhere.

options.title: Build a broader form/dialog API
options.body: Treat multi-select as one field within a larger deterministic data-collection contract, accepting substantially greater scope and state-management complexity.

options.title: Keep channel-specific only
options.body: Allow individual channel plugins to expose native selection workflows without promising a portable message-tool contract.

recommendation.title: Add a portable presentation block
recommendation.body: Define an additive typed multi-select contract with structured array results, ship Discord and Slack native implementations first, and require deterministic text fallback elsewhere.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing review and current-main history place this decision at the shared message-presentation and plugin-SDK boundary.
